verdict: ONEOK's profit jumped as record Permian Basin volumes lifted pipeline earnings — helped by a one-time $336M tax benefit.

segments.name: Commodity sales
segments.note: Natural gas, NGLs, refined products and crude oil sold — priced off energy markets, so this line swings with commodity prices.

segments.name: Services and other
segments.note: Fees for gathering, processing, transporting and storing energy for producers and shippers.

opex.name: Operations & maintenance
opex.note: Running and maintaining 60,000 miles of pipelines and processing plants.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: The wear-and-tear cost of pipelines and plants, spread over their lives.

opex.name: Transaction costs
opex.note: Deal costs, mainly for the Brazos Midland acquisition.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $415M, partly offset by $102M of other income, $103M of equity earnings from joint ventures and a $26M net income-tax benefit — a net $184M drag in this step of the chart.

follow100.label: Equity earnings, other income & tax benefit

takeaways.title: Revenue surged, mostly commodity sales
takeaways.text: Revenue hit $12.5B, up from $8.6B a year ago. Most of it — $11.2B — is commodity sales priced off energy markets, so the top line moves with prices as much as with volumes.

takeaways.title: A one-time tax benefit flattered profit
takeaways.text: A reorganization tied to the $9B minority equity investment created a one-time, noncash tax benefit of $336M ($0.53 a share). Without it, the tax line would have been a normal expense.

takeaways.title: The pipelines themselves kept growing
takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA rose 6% to $2.24B on record Permian volumes — NGL throughput up 6% — and ONEOK raised its full-year 2026 guidance again.

oneTimers: A one-time, noncash income tax benefit of $336M ($0.53 per diluted share) from the ONEOK, Inc. reorganization related to the $9B minority equity investment — it is why the quarter's tax line is a small net benefit ($26M) instead of an expense.

Results also include a $53M net benefit tied to the minority-equity and Brazos Midland transactions, mainly gains on early debt repayment; ONEOK repaid nearly $5.5B of debt principal in September 2026.
footerNote: Net income shown ($1,384M) is before $34M attributable to noncontrolling interests (attributable: $1,350M).
follow100Note: ONEOK's segment revenues include $2,060M of intersegment sales eliminated in consolidation, so revenue is split by type (commodity sales vs services) instead of by segment. Segment adjusted EBITDA: Gathering & Processing $563M, Natural Gas Liquids $718M, Natural Gas Pipelines $231M, Refined Products & Crude $685M. The $26M net tax benefit is folded into the other-income step of the flow, so tax shows as $0M.
